title: HashMap insert and optional lookup
summary: Insert a value into Lean's Std.HashMap and retrieve it at an equivalent key; lookups at other keys retain their previous result.

source.statement: {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [BEq α] [Hashable α] {m : Std.HashMap α β} [EquivBEq α] [LawfulHashable α] {k a : α} {v : β} : (m.insert k v)[a]? = if k == a then some v else m[a]?

assumptions: BEq α defines an equivalence relation (EquivBEq α).
Hashable α respects that equivalence (LawfulHashable α).
The map is Std.HashMap, whose underlying DHashMap bundles its well-formedness invariant.

reuse: Use leanprover/lean4:v4.35.0 at commit eb6cafb7290e8bd5f2937522d8d804f58f02bafc. Import Std.Data.HashMap.Lemmas and apply Std.HashMap.getElem?_insert. The accompanying local HashMapInsert.lean package re-exports the same contract as OharaHashMap.lookup_insert; Consumer.lean demonstrates insertion, replacement and an unchanged lookup.
